queries.compiledQueryString: select distinct league from mlb.standings order by league
queries.inputQueryString: select distinct league from mlb.standings order by league

queries.compiledQueryString:
select
    team_name, abbrev, league, division, elo, elo_rank,
    wins, losses, projected_wins,
    p_make_playoffs, p_win_division, p_win_pennant, p_win_world_series
from mlb.standings
where league like '${inputs.league.value}'
order by p_win_world_series desc
